title: Why you cannot catch a fly

sentences.text: A fly sits on the table.
You move your hand very fast.
The fly is already gone.
It happens every time.
Your hand is fast. The fly is faster.
But it is not about speed.
It is about time.
A fly sees the world slowly.
Not slow like tired.
Slow like a film in slow motion.
sentences.translationRu: Медленно, как фильм в замедленной съёмке.

sentences.text: Your eyes take pictures of the world.
About sixty pictures every second.
A fly takes about two hundred and fifty.
Four times more than you.
sentences.translationRu: В четыре раза больше, чем ты.

sentences.text: So your hand moves through the air.
You see one movement.
The fly sees many small steps.
It has time to think.
Well, time to react.
There is a second problem for you.
sentences.translationRu: Есть и вторая проблема для тебя.

sentences.text: The fly does not jump straight up.
First it leans away from the danger.
It moves its legs before it jumps.
This takes about one tenth of a second.
sentences.translationRu: На это уходит примерно одна десятая секунды.

sentences.text: Then it goes the other way.
sentences.translationRu: А потом уходит в другую сторону.

sentences.text: So it is never where you aim.
sentences.translationRu: Поэтому она никогда не там, куда ты целишься.

sentences.text: It is a little to the side.
Its eyes help too.
A fly has thousands of small eyes.
Together they see almost everything.
In front, behind, above.
It does not need to turn its head.
So how do people catch them?
Move slowly, not quickly.
A slow hand is boring to a fly.
Or aim in front of it, not at it.
sentences.translationRu: Или целься перед ней, а не в неё.

sentences.text: Aim where it is going to be.
Which is a strange way to catch something.
But it works better.
Almost all food goes bad.
Bread after a week. Milk after days.
sentences.translationRu: Хлеб за неделю. Молоко за пару дней.

sentences.text: Even dry food goes bad in the end.
sentences.translationRu: Даже сухая еда в конце концов портится.

sentences.text: Honey does not.
Not in a year. Not in a hundred.
sentences.translationRu: Ни за год. Ни за сто.

sentences.text: People have found honey in old tombs.
Thousands of years old.
And it was still honey.
sentences.translationRu: И это всё ещё был мёд.

sentences.text: Food goes bad because of small living things.
sentences.translationRu: Еда портится из-за мелких живых существ.

sentences.text: Bacteria and moulds.
They eat the food and they grow.
To do that they need water.
sentences.translationRu: А для этого им нужна вода.

sentences.text: Honey has almost none.
It is about eighty per cent sugar.
sentences.translationRu: Он примерно на восемьдесят процентов сахар.

sentences.text: Sugar holds water very tightly.
A bacterium landing in honey
loses its own water to the sugar.
It dries out and dies.
The honey is not fighting it.
It is simply too dry to live in.
sentences.translationRu: Он просто слишком сухой, чтобы в нём жить.

sentences.text: There is a second reason.
Honey is acid.
More acid than most things you eat.
sentences.translationRu: Кислее большинства того, что ты ешь.

sentences.text: Most bacteria do not like acid.
And there is a third reason.
Bees add something from their own bodies.
sentences.translationRu: Пчёлы добавляют кое-что из собственного тела.

sentences.text: It makes a tiny amount of a chemical.
sentences.translationRu: Оно даёт совсем немного одного вещества.

sentences.text: The same one people put on a cut.
sentences.translationRu: Того самого, что льют на порез.

sentences.text: So honey cleans itself, very slowly.
sentences.translationRu: Так что мёд очень медленно чистит себя сам.

sentences.text: This is why people used it on wounds.
For thousands of years, before medicine.
Some hospitals use it again now.
For burns that will not close.
But honey has one enemy.
sentences.translationRu: Но у мёда есть один враг.

sentences.text: Water.
Leave the jar open in a wet room
sentences.translationRu: Оставь банку открытой во влажной комнате —

sentences.text: and honey pulls water out of the air.
sentences.translationRu: и мёд вытянет воду из воздуха.

sentences.text: Then it can go bad like anything else.
sentences.translationRu: И тогда он испортится, как всё остальное.

sentences.text: So the lid is the whole secret.
sentences.translationRu: Так что весь секрет — в крышке.

title: Why the covers in the street are round

sentences.text: Walk down any street and look down.
sentences.translationRu: Пройдись по улице и посмотри вниз.

sentences.text: There are metal covers in the road.
They cover holes that go under the city.
sentences.translationRu: Они закрывают люки, ведущие под город.

sentences.text: Almost all of them are round.
Not square. Not triangles.
Round, in every country.
There is a very good reason.
sentences.translationRu: И на то есть очень веская причина.

sentences.text: A round cover cannot fall in.
Think about a square cover.
Each side is, say, one metre.
But the line from corner to corner
sentences.translationRu: Но линия от угла до угла

sentences.text: is longer than one metre.
So turn the cover on its side.
And put it in at an angle.
It will go straight down the hole.
Onto somebody working below.
A circle has no corners.
Every line across it is the same.
So there is no angle that works.
sentences.translationRu: Значит, нет угла, под которым это выйдет.

sentences.text: It simply cannot fit through.
There are other good reasons too.
A cover is very heavy.
Sixty kilograms is normal.
You cannot lift it and carry it.
But you can roll a circle.
A square you would have to drag.
And a round cover needs no turning.
sentences.translationRu: И круглую крышку не надо поворачивать.

sentences.text: Put it back in any direction.
It always fits.
A square one has to be lined up.
At night, in the rain, that matters.
The hole under it is round too.
For a different reason.
Earth pushes in from every side.
A circle is the strongest answer to that.
sentences.translationRu: Круг — самый прочный ответ на это.

sentences.text: A square would crack at the corners.
This question is famous.
Companies once asked it in job interviews.
sentences.translationRu: Компании когда-то задавали его на собеседованиях.

sentences.text: Most people say: so it does not fall in.
Which is right, and only the first reason.
sentences.translationRu: И это верно — но лишь первая причина.

title: Fighters are weighed the day before, and that is the problem

sentences.text: Combat sports are divided by weight.
The reason is obvious and good.
A heavier person hits harder.
So people should fight people their own size.
sentences.translationRu: Значит, драться надо с равными по размеру.

sentences.text: The rule is simple. The practice is not.
In most organisations fighters are weighed
about twenty-four hours before the fight.
That gap is the whole issue.
sentences.translationRu: Этот промежуток и есть вся проблема.

sentences.text: Because it creates a strange race.
sentences.translationRu: Потому что он создаёт странную гонку.

sentences.text: Not who is strongest at their weight.
But who can be lightest for one minute.
sentences.translationRu: А «кто может быть легче всех одну минуту».

sentences.text: And heaviest a day later.
Most of the body is water.
Water can be removed quickly.
And put back almost as quickly.
sentences.translationRu: И почти так же быстро вернуть.

sentences.text: So fighters cut water, not fat.
sentences.translationRu: Поэтому бойцы сгоняют воду, а не жир.

sentences.text: They stop drinking.
They sit in hot rooms in heavy clothes.
sentences.translationRu: Сидят в жарких помещениях в плотной одежде.

sentences.text: They lose five kilograms in two days.
sentences.translationRu: Теряют пять килограммов за два дня.

sentences.text: Sometimes eight, sometimes more.
They step on the scale.
Then they drink and eat for a day.
sentences.translationRu: А потом сутки пьют и едят.

sentences.text: And arrive at the fight much heavier.
sentences.translationRu: И приходят на бой намного тяжелее.

sentences.text: Sometimes ten kilograms heavier.
So the categories no longer mean much.
Two people in the same class
can be very different sizes in the ring.
sentences.translationRu: могут быть очень разного размера в ринге.

sentences.text: The costs are not only about fairness.
A dehydrated brain sits differently in the skull.
sentences.translationRu: Обезвоженный мозг иначе сидит в черепе.

sentences.text: The fluid around it protects it from shaking.
sentences.translationRu: Жидкость вокруг защищает его от сотрясения.

sentences.text: Take the fluid away and that protection drops.
Doctors have warned about this for years.
Fighters have died during weight cuts.
Not in fights. In hotel rooms, before them.
sentences.translationRu: Не в боях. В гостиничных номерах, до них.

sentences.text: The fixes are known and simple.
Weigh people on the day, not the day before.
sentences.translationRu: Взвешивать в день боя, а не накануне.

sentences.text: Or weigh them twice, and check the difference.
sentences.translationRu: Или взвешивать дважды и сверять разницу.

sentences.text: Some organisations have done this.
Most have not.
Because a fighter who cuts well
sentences.translationRu: Потому что боец, который хорошо сгоняет вес,

sentences.text: has a real advantage right now.
And nobody wants to give that up first.
sentences.translationRu: И никто не хочет отказываться первым.

title: No river runs straight for long

sentences.text: Look at any river from above.
It bends. Then it bends back.
Over and over, across a flat plain.
sentences.translationRu: Снова и снова, по плоской равнине.

sentences.text: Which is odd, if you think about it.
Water is trying to get downhill.
The shortest way down is a straight line.
So why does no river take it?
sentences.translationRu: Почему же ни одна река так не идёт?

sentences.text: The answer is that a straight river
sentences.translationRu: Ответ в том, что прямая река

sentences.text: is not a stable arrangement.
Any tiny disturbance grows.
A fallen branch. A patch of softer soil.
sentences.translationRu: Упавшая ветка. Пятно более мягкого грунта.

sentences.text: The water turns very slightly.
And once it turns, something begins.
sentences.translationRu: И стоит ей отклониться, как начинается процесс.

sentences.text: Water on the outside of a bend
moves faster than water on the inside.
Faster water carries more material.
So it cuts into the outer bank.
Meanwhile the inside is slower.
Slow water drops what it is carrying.
sentences.translationRu: Медленная вода роняет то, что несёт.

sentences.text: So sand builds up on the inside.
sentences.translationRu: И на внутренней стороне намывается песок.

sentences.text: Cut on one side, build on the other.
sentences.translationRu: Режет с одной стороны, строит с другой.

sentences.text: The bend gets deeper.
And a deeper bend turns the water harder.
sentences.translationRu: А более глубокий изгиб сильнее закручивает воду.

sentences.text: Which cuts harder still.
Nothing stops it except the bend meeting itself.
sentences.translationRu: Остановить это может лишь встреча изгиба с самим собой.

sentences.text: Eventually two bends touch.
sentences.translationRu: В конце концов два изгиба соприкасаются.

sentences.text: The river takes the short cut.
And the old loop is left behind.
sentences.translationRu: А старая петля остаётся в стороне.

sentences.text: Cut off, holding still water.
You can see them from a plane.
Curved lakes beside a river
that no longer runs through them.
sentences.translationRu: которая через них больше не течёт.

sentences.text: There is a pattern in all of this.
Measure the length of a bend
against the width of the river.
The ratio is roughly the same everywhere.
On a huge river and on a stream.
sentences.translationRu: И на огромной реке, и на ручье.

sentences.text: And in meltwater channels on ice.
sentences.translationRu: И в талых руслах на льду.

sentences.text: Where there is no soil to erode at all.
Which tells you it is not about the ground.
sentences.translationRu: А это говорит, что дело не в грунте.

sentences.text: It is about how moving water behaves.
sentences.translationRu: Дело в том, как ведёт себя текущая вода.

sentences.text: Straightening a river is therefore temporary.
Engineers did it for centuries.
The river spends the next century undoing it.

title: We use it every day and cannot explain it

sentences.text: General anaesthesia is routine.
Hundreds of thousands of times a day.
A person is given a drug.
Within a minute they are gone.
Not asleep. Somewhere else entirely.
sentences.translationRu: Не спит. Совсем в другом месте.

sentences.text: Then they come back, hours later.
With nothing in between.
It is the single most useful thing
that medicine has ever been handed.
Before it, surgery was a race.
Speed was the main skill a surgeon had.
A leg came off in under a minute.
sentences.translationRu: Ногу отнимали меньше чем за минуту.

sentences.text: Because the patient was awake.
sentences.translationRu: Потому что пациент был в сознании.

sentences.text: Anything inside the body was impossible.
sentences.translationRu: Всё, что внутри тела, было невозможно.

sentences.text: Anaesthesia made modern surgery exist.
And here is the uncomfortable part.
Nobody fully understands how it works.
sentences.translationRu: Никто до конца не понимает, как он работает.

sentences.text: Not roughly. Not in outline.
sentences.translationRu: Не приблизительно. Не в общих чертах.

sentences.text: The mechanism is genuinely open.
Parts of it are understood.
The drugs act on particular channels
in the membranes of nerve cells.
Some quieten the cells that excite.
Some strengthen the cells that calm.
That much is measurable.
What is not clear is the jump.
How quieter cells become no experience.
sentences.translationRu: Как приглушённые клетки становятся отсутствием опыта.

sentences.text: Sleep is not the same thing at all.
sentences.translationRu: Со сном это совсем не одно и то же.

sentences.text: A sleeping brain is highly active.
It dreams, it responds, it can be woken.
sentences.translationRu: Он видит сны, отвечает, его можно разбудить.

sentences.text: An anaesthetised brain does none of that.
sentences.translationRu: Мозг под наркозом не делает ничего из этого.

sentences.text: The patterns across it break apart.
Regions stop talking to each other.
sentences.translationRu: Области перестают говорить друг с другом.

sentences.text: Each part still works.
They simply stop forming one thing.
sentences.translationRu: Они просто перестают складываться в одно.

sentences.text: That observation is the most useful clue we have.
sentences.translationRu: Это наблюдение — самая полезная наша подсказка.

sentences.text: It suggests that being conscious
sentences.translationRu: Оно намекает, что быть в сознании —

sentences.text: is not produced by any one region.
sentences.translationRu: это не продукт какой-то одной области.

sentences.text: It is the whole thing being connected.
Which is a claim about the mind
that arrived from an operating theatre.
Rather than from philosophy.

title: Why the same meal tastes worse at altitude

sentences.text: Airline food has a poor reputation.
sentences.translationRu: У еды в самолётах дурная слава.

sentences.text: Most of it is undeserved.
The same meal, cooked identically
sentences.translationRu: То же блюдо, приготовленное так же

sentences.text: and eaten on the ground, tastes normal.
sentences.translationRu: и съеденное на земле, на вкус нормальное.

sentences.text: The problem is not the kitchen.
It is the room it is eaten in.
sentences.translationRu: А в помещении, где его едят.

sentences.text: Three things are happening at once.
The first is dryness.
Cabin air is drier than most deserts.
sentences.translationRu: Воздух в салоне суше большинства пустынь.

sentences.text: Around ten to twenty per cent humidity.
Smell requires a wet surface.
Molecules have to dissolve to be detected.
sentences.translationRu: Молекулы должны раствориться, чтобы их уловили.

sentences.text: A dry nose detects considerably less.
And most of taste is smell.
sentences.translationRu: А вкус — это по большей части запах.

sentences.text: The second is pressure.
A cabin is kept at roughly the pressure
sentences.translationRu: В салоне поддерживают давление примерно как

sentences.text: of a town two thousand metres up.
sentences.translationRu: в городке на двух тысячах метров.

sentences.text: Which is comfortable, and not sea level.
sentences.translationRu: Это комфортно — и это не уровень моря.

sentences.text: Lower pressure reduces sensitivity
to sweet and to salt specifically.
Measured drops of around thirty per cent.
Sour, bitter and spice are barely affected.
sentences.translationRu: Кислое, горькое и острое почти не страдают.

sentences.text: Which distorts a dish rather than dulling it.
sentences.translationRu: Это не притупляет блюдо, а перекашивает его.

sentences.text: Salt and sugar retreat.
Everything else stays where it was.
The third is noise, which is the surprise.
A cabin runs at around eighty-five decibels.
sentences.translationRu: В салоне около восьмидесяти пяти децибел.

sentences.text: At that level, experiments show
that sweetness is suppressed further.
And one taste is enhanced instead.
Umami, the savoury one.
Which is why tomato juice sells on aircraft
sentences.translationRu: Поэтому томатный сок продаётся в самолётах

sentences.text: far out of proportion to its sales on the ground.
Airlines noticed the pattern long before
sentences.translationRu: Авиакомпании заметили закономерность задолго до того,

sentences.text: anyone explained it.
Kitchens now cook for the cabin, not the plate.
sentences.translationRu: Кухни теперь готовят под салон, а не под тарелку.

sentences.text: More salt and more acid than seems right.
sentences.translationRu: Больше соли и кислоты, чем кажется правильным.

sentences.text: Strong stocks. Dishes built on umami.
sentences.translationRu: Крепкие бульоны. Блюда, построенные на умами.

sentences.text: Sauces that would be crude at a table.
sentences.translationRu: Соусы, которые за столом были бы грубыми.

sentences.text: There is a broader point buried in it.
sentences.translationRu: В этом зарыт более широкий вывод.

sentences.text: Taste is usually described as a property of food.
sentences.translationRu: Вкус обычно описывают как свойство еды.

sentences.text: It behaves much more like a property
sentences.translationRu: Ведёт он себя куда больше как свойство

sentences.text: of the situation the food arrives in.
